Molmo2 (Multimodal Open Language Model 2) is a fully open Vision-Language Model (VLM) family developed by the Allen Institute for AI and the University of Washington. Its defining capability is **video grounding**: identifying when and where an event or object appears within a video.

This book examines the open data pipeline, model family, and grounding evaluations behind that capability, including the reported comparisons with proprietary systems.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.10611) · [Code](https://github.com/allenai/molmo2) · [Demo](https://playground.allenai.org)
